text:
elaine: Heads-up 3 enterprise wants a Console view that ties route-level errors and latency regressions to dollar impact. They specifically asked for: route cost breakdown, sampled traces tied to spikes, and an export they can drop into BI. Quick sketch + questions below.

rob: Good clarity. My main concern is overhead. We should keep dataplane extra CPU <8% and add an opt-in per-tenant flag.

sasha: Storage will bite if we keep raw traces. Suggest sampling defaults + error/anomaly always sampled. Retention: 10d full traces, 90d aggregates. Compression + dedupe needed.

praveen: Implementation approach: compute cheap per-request delta (tokens + model multiplier) synchronously, then enqueue a compact envelope async. Sample before heavy marshal. Use route overrides for sampling.

joan: Product constraints: RBAC for billing vs eng, CSV export for finance, and PII redaction toggle for Private installs (KMS tagging). These are GA blockers for regulated customers.

elaine: Proposed MVP surface: route token meter (top-20), cost-per-1k by model family, sampled trace links from spikes, a "cost incident" report export, RBAC + redaction toggle.

rob: Rollout idea: feature-flagged canary (5% tenants) for 72h, synth traffic + real traffic. Gate on: p95 latency uplift <5%, error-rate uplift <0.2pp, infra spend delta <15% during canary. If any breach, auto-roll back.

sasha: Default sampling suggestion: 0.02% global, routes with high QPS allowed lower rates, error/anomaly forced sample. We need a Console control for per-project overrides and a visible sampling meter.

praveen: Perf note: prefer a tiny protobuf envelope with only keys we need (route, tokens, model id, duration estimate, error flag). Batch and upload off-host to blob store; index asynchronously.

elaine: Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Functional: route-level cost + token breakdown visible in Console for top-20 routes
- Observability: sampled trace link in dashboard that opens raw trace if available
- Perf: dataplane CPU overhead <8% in stress tests
- Economics: telemetry storage delta target <+12% infra spend first quarter; hard guardrail +25% for exec approval
- Security: redaction toggle + KMS tagging for Private
- UX: one dashboard template + export button for finance

joan: Prioritization question: is this a committed enterprise ask? If yes mark P0 next quarter; otherwise P1.

elaine: Confirmed customer-driven (top-10). Recommend P0. Next steps:
- Rob: canary orchestration + synth tests (owner) 3 due Thu
- Praveen: proto-envelope + perf sims (owner) 3 due Wed
- Sasha: storage cost model + sampling UX (owner) 3 due Fri
- Joan: RBAC/export/redaction checklist + customer vignette (owner) 3 due 5d
